title: Named for a place, living somewhere else?
excerpt: Thousands of species are named after a place. I matched 2,901 of them to GBIF records: 98% of those I could test are recorded in that country. The coco de mer, named for the Maldives, grows in the Seychelles.
seo_description: Do species named after a place live there? 98% are recorded in that country; the coco de mer is named for the Maldives but grows in the Seychelles.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'Named for a place, living somewhere else?' beside a world map of green and red dots at the places species are named after, with a red arrow from the Maldives to the Seychelles.
